archetypes.name: dyn-ratchet-metrics
archetypes.rationale: Content-token ratchet semantics are the core behavior change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed skill closure metric computation and baseline serialization. Check that blank-line-only edits stay content-token neutral, while meaningful content growth fails even if line count drops. Verify edge cases for files with only blank lines and files without trailing newlines. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-cli-filter
archetypes.rationale: The new --skill filter must not weaken canonical baseline writes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the --skill and --write control flow in the skill closure linter. Confirm check mode scans only the requested gated skill, unknown skills fail closed, and write mode always regenerates the full canonical baseline. Pay special attention to the --write plus --skill rejection path and baseline integrity. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
